messages.name: Gringotts Financial admin
messages.body: Do we need our own retry logic with the Python SDK?

messages.name: Leo (Support)
messages.body: The Python SDK retries IP-4290, IP-4291, IP-5000, and IP-5030 automatically with backoff, up to max_retries (default 2). It never retries 4xx validation errors like IP-4220. Pass idempotency_key on creates so retries are safe.

messages.name: Gringotts Financial admin
messages.body: OK. Please let us know when it's fixed.
